name: ic10-bench-repo
description: IC10 Bench: automated tests and a VS Code debugger for Stationeers IC10 scripts

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/ic10-lint/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/ic10-bench/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/ic10-link/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/vscode/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run build:lib -w vendor/ic10 && npm run build -w packages/ic10-lint && npm run build -w packages/ic10-bench && npm run build -w packages/ic10-link && npm run build -w packages/vscode
